objective: Validate the Vercel-to-Blitz direct WebContainer bridge without depending on the StackBlitz UI origin

jobs.command: node -e "const assert=require('node:assert/strict'); const p={executor:'STACKBLITZ_WEBCONTAINER',bridge:'VERCEL_FUNCTION_CHROMIUM',transport:'DIRECT_WEBCONTAINER',script:'bridge:direct',zeroSpend:true,approval:true,liveOrder:false,arbitraryRemoteCode:false}; assert.equal(p.executor,'STACKBLITZ_WEBCONTAINER'); assert.equal(p.bridge,'VERCEL_FUNCTION_CHROMIUM'); assert.equal(p.transport,'DIRECT_WEBCONTAINER'); assert.equal(p.script,'bridge:direct'); assert.equal(p.zeroSpend,true); assert.equal(p.approval,true); assert.equal(p.liveOrder,false); assert.equal(p.arbitraryRemoteCode,false); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',...p}))"
